title: Nvidia Backs 4 German Firms in $10B European AI Push
summary:
Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang and German Chancellor Friedrich Merz signed a partnership in Berlin to develop physical AI models for the manufacturing and automotive sectors. As part of this push into industrial AI, Nvidia announced investments in four German startups: Agile Robots, a maker of humanoid factory robots; Avelios Medical, an AI hospital software firm; Mirelo, a generative audio company; and Reflex Aerospace. Reflex Aerospace plans to use the capital to expand its satellite platform architecture and scale production in Bavaria.

These ventures are part of a nearly $10B commitment by Nvidia across Europe to establish its AI platform in industrial automation and healthcare. The funding follows a statement by Merz that Nvidia intends to invest billions in the domestic economy to integrate artificial intelligence into German industry. Reflex Aerospace expects to launch its first satellites in about 12 months as it scales its European operations.
